name: A Parthenium Weed Growth Stage Image Dataset
description: Parthenium Hysterophorus, is a highly invasive annual herb that poses a significant global concern due to its negative impacts on agriculture, biodiversity, human health, and the environment. Parthenium weed control measure vary depending on the growth stage of the weed. In this dataset, an RGB imgae dataset representing three Parthenium growth stages as three categories (and the background as the fourth category) is presented.
